name: Lajoskomárom (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lajoskomárom: a crowned light blue shield with a red and green base and a Hungarian shield, with yellow mantling.
history: The arms and flag of Lajoskomárom were created in 1993; they refer to the village's three denominations and its agriculture. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lajoskomárom arms with crown and mantling
